title: U.S.-China Extend Trade Truce to Jan. 10 as Xi Jinping Arrives in Washington
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. and China agreed to extend their existing trade truce — the Busan Agreement — from November until January 10, giving negotiating teams more time for a broader deal. Xi Jinping attended a state dinner at the White House with tech leaders including Nvidia's Jensen Huang, Apple's Tim Cook, and OpenAI's Sam Altman.
why: 贸易休战续期到1月10日，降低年末关税升级风险；阿里、腾讯、美团等港股与ADR持仓直接受益于中美关系缓和。英伟达黄仁勋出席国宴也暗示芯片管制存在协商空间，对NVDA隐含波动率具正面含义。

title: Hong Kong Stocks Fall 1% as U.S. Bond Rout and Iran War Stalemate Weigh; Tech Leads Decline
summary: The Hang Seng Index fell 1.01% to 24,510.09 on September 25, with the Hang Seng Tech Index dropping 1.13%. Alibaba and Xiaomi fell over 3%; NetEase dropped 3.05%. Stock Connect northbound flows were suspended September 25–27 for the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday, removing mainland China's incremental support. U.S. 10- and 30-year Treasury yields hit their highest levels since 2007 and 2004 respectively, raising global discount rates.
why: 恒指跌1%、北水暂停三天，科网股普遭抛售；持有港股多头时需注意中秋节后(9/29起)交易量恢复时方向。美债收益率续升影响高估值科技股期权隐含波动率，sell put 行权价参考需留更大安全垫。

title: Michigan Consumer Sentiment Final 48.1 in September, Near 4-Month Low; 1-Year Inflation Expectations Hit 4.6%
summary: The University of Michigan's Index of Consumer Sentiment fell to 48.1 in September from 51.7 in August, down 7% month-over-month and the lowest since May. Year-ahead inflation expectations climbed to 4.6%, the highest since June. Both Current Conditions (50.9) and Expectations (45.8) components declined, with respondents citing elevated fuel prices, trade disputes, and high interest rates.
why: 消费者信心走弱、通胀预期反弹，支持美联储继续偏鹰立场（市场预期10月或再加息25bp）。对持有消费类股（Costco、McDonald's、沃尔玛）的sell put策略而言，需关注零售需求后劲，同时高利率环境对成长股期权隐含波动率有压制。

title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Tops App Store Charts; Alphabet Drops 3% on Competitive Pressure
summary: Meta launched Muse, a consumer AI agent handling email, travel, bookings and purchases in the background; it surpassed 2.5 million downloads and became the No. 1 free app on the iPhone App Store. Alphabet fell 3% on September 23 as Muse directly integrates with Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Docs. Meta also unveiled the Muse Charm pendant at its Connect conference.
why: Google/Alphabet (GOOGL) 是组合持仓，Meta Muse的爆款上线直接冲击谷歌搜索广告与助手变现空间；若GOOGL持仓有covered call，可考虑是否调低行权价；同时AI生态竞争加剧将抬升整体大型科技股的隐含波动率。

title: S&P 500 Flat on September 25 as Surging Bond Yields and Oil Prices Test Investors
summary: U.S. equities closed largely flat on September 25, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq essentially unchanged as rising Treasury yields—10-year at multi-year highs—and elevated oil prices (tied to Iran war) offset gains from the U.S.-China trade truce. Consumer sentiment data weaker than pre-2020 lows added to cautious mood.
why: 美股宽幅横盘但内部分化：美债收益率维持高位压制估值倍数，能源股因伊朗战争维持强势；科技股期权隐含波动率较历史均值偏高，sell put 可适度扩大到期时间。

title: 腾讯控股(00700) 9月25日斥资1亿港元回购23.1万股
summary: 腾讯控股9月25日公告，当日斥资约1亿港元在公开市场回购23.1万股普通股。前一日（9月24日）已回购约23万股耗资1.01亿港元，回购节奏持续。
why: 腾讯回购依旧积极，彰显管理层认为当前股价被低估；北水中秋节期间暂停，回购支撑作用更为关键。对持有腾讯或相关科技股sell put头寸者，回购提供一定价格支撑底线。注意：具体数字未通过HKEXnews一手核实，已标verified:false。

title: Tesla Opens Nevada Semi Factory Targeting 50,000 Trucks/Year; First Deliveries to PepsiCo and DHL
summary: Tesla inaugurated its dedicated Semi electric truck manufacturing facility in Sparks, Nevada on September 25, targeting 50,000 units per year at roughly 1,000 trucks/week; it will bring over 3,000 jobs. First deliveries went to PepsiCo, DHL, and US Foods. CEO Musk addressed the crowd via pre-recorded video calling Semi "a breakthrough product for heavy shipping." TSLA stock fell 1.54% on the day amid analyst price-target cuts.
why: Semi量产启动是特斯拉产品线扩张的里程碑，但商用车周期长、毛利较低；股价当日下跌反映市场对FSD延误欧洲审批的失望。持有TSLA sell put者需注意量产初期产能爬坡的执行风险，可考虑短期covered call获益。

title: Costco Q4 FY2026: Net Sales $93.9B (+11.2%), EPS $6.75 Beat Estimates; Full-Year Revenue $297.2B
summary: Costco reported Q4 FY2026 results: net sales rose 11.2% to $93.9B; diluted EPS of $6.75 beat consensus ~$6.52, although $0.15 of EPS came from one-time IEEPA tariff refunds. Membership fee income grew 10.7% to $1.373B with executive penetration at 75%. FY2027 plan: open 33 warehouses. Stock rose in after-hours trading.
why: 好市多业绩扎实；核心EPS（剔除关税退款约$6.60）仍超预期，会员体系韧性强。消费端持续健康，对整体消费赛道是正面信号。持有COST的sell put可延续——但需关注10月是否加息25bp带来的贴现率压力。

title: Binance Invests $100M in Circle (CRCL) and Signs 5-Year USDC Expansion Partnership
summary: Circle Internet Group (CRCL) announced Binance made a $100M equity investment (1,237,011 Class A shares at $80.84 each) and signed a new 5-year commercial agreement to expand USDC adoption across emerging markets. Baird reiterated an outperform rating post-announcement. Circle's Arc blockchain, with BlackRock as a founding validator, launched September 16.
why: 币安战略入股+5年USDC合作协议，为CRCL提供增量增长背书，也强化USDC在跨境支付赛道的地位。对持有CRCL或稳定币赛道敞口者是正面催化；稳定币法案（GENIUS Act）若年内通过将进一步利好。宣布4天前，属延续报道，仍在发酵（Baird持续跟进报道）。
